briefs: room-dune

Interior of a compact 26 m² garden-facing bedroom. Low king bed with ivory linen, oak bench, deep arched window opening to marram-grass dune garden, warm oak door, reading lamp and simple desk. Camera from doorway, 35mm lens, whole room with credible modest scale, soft morning daylight.
room-courtyard

Interior of a 32 m² bedroom around a sheltered planted stone courtyard. Wide arched opening to an olive tree and pale courtyard walls, king bed with linen, oak floor, simple reading chair and floor lamp. Side daylight, intimate enclosure, no sea view. 35mm camera at human eye level.
room-atlantic

Interior of a 38 m² west-facing bedroom. Broad window frames the Atlantic horizon and private stone terrace with two plain oak chairs. Low king bed at left with linen, warm oak floor, limestone wall, evening sunlight raking floor. Camera sees both bed and clear sea view; believable wide room.
room-suite

Interior of the 54 m² Sora Suite, a single-storey suite with bedroom visible through a wide plaster opening and a separate lounge in foreground. Oak-framed sofa in linen, low stone hearth with unlit fireplace, quiet reading lamp, terrace and uninterrupted Atlantic horizon beyond deep arch. Show credible separate living and sleeping spaces.
detail-dune

Intimate secondary view inside the garden-facing Dune Room: low linen bed, oak bench and deep window sill with a closed book; dune grasses visible outside. Camera at mattress height, side morning light, emphasis on simple construction and tactile bedding. No ocean view.
detail-courtyard

Secondary view of a Courtyard Room through a wide plaster arch to a sheltered stone courtyard with a single olive tree. A linen reading chair and oak side table in foreground, bed edge at left. Soft midday shade, believable indoor-outdoor threshold, no sea view.
detail-atlantic

Secondary view from the Atlantic Room terrace looking through an open oak door toward the linen bed, with sea horizon visible at right. Two simple oak chairs on pale stone, raking afternoon shadows, human eye-level 50mm lens. Architectural detail, not an aerial.
detail-suite

Secondary view of the Sora Suite separate lounge: long linen sofa, low oak table, books and a stone fireplace, deep arched opening to the Atlantic terrace. Bedroom is not the focal point. Warm late afternoon light, natural imperfections, restrained furniture.
dining-table

The Sora Table dining room: one long solid oak table, simple oak chairs, a few ivory ceramic plates, linen napkins and clear glasses, discreet pendant lights switched off, deep plaster arches framing courtyard daylight. No food feast, no people, no ornate styling. Wide composed photograph.
quiet-bath

A quiet bathing room with a freestanding pale stone bath, folded ivory linen, a small oak stool and soft light entering one deep arched courtyard window. Limestone floor, lime plaster, calm tactile surfaces, realistic plumbing, no steam haze or candles.
coastal-path

Atlantic Portugal coastal landscape seen at walking height: narrow sandy footpath through low marram-grass dunes toward a broad calm sea and one clear horizon. Same natural stone/ivory/coastal palette as house reference, soft late afternoon. No buildings, cliffs, mountains, crowds, tropical plants, umbrellas, sunrise red or drone view.
lime-plaster

Close architectural material photograph: warm ivory lime plaster with a deep rounded window reveal and subtle oak edge, raking afternoon daylight creates a sharply legible soft-edged shadow. Tactile plaster detail with real surface variation, clearly composed shape rather than blank beige texture. No text or objects.
arrival-path

A ground-level approach photograph of the reference house. Narrow pale gravel path between low dune grass leading to one deep stone arch and an open oak door. Maintain the exact building identity, single-storey limestone and lime plaster, quiet afternoon daylight, natural textures.
facade-detail

Portrait architectural detail photograph of two adjacent deep rounded arches at the reference house, pale limestone and ivory lime plaster, oak-framed glass door in one arch, a sliver of dune and Atlantic at the side, low afternoon light making long shadows, tactile stone joints and realistic construction.
oak-detail

Close architectural photograph inside the reference house: warm natural oak joinery meets a lime-plaster wall and pale stone ledge, clear wood grain and a softly worn edge, raking daylight with a readable shadow, intimate tactile framing, no text, no people.
linen-detail

Close editorial photograph of ivory washed linen folded over the edge of a low oak bed, subtle creases, natural weave, a narrow band of pale stone floor and plaster wall, soft side daylight, realistic textile texture, restrained styling, no people.
